No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

In this workshop you create ethical photographic records that document context and detail.

All materials are provided. The session is adapted to your space, your timetable and the age of the participants.

What it covers

  • Orientation and visual ethics
  • Plan repeatable photographic views
  • Field capture at public-access site
  • Metadata and caption review

How the time is spent

  1. Orientation and visual ethics 25 min

  2. Plan repeatable photographic views 50 min

  3. Field capture at public-access site 65 min

  4. Metadata and caption review 40 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Apply visual ethics when making photographic records at a public-access heritage site.
  • Plan repeatable photographic views that document both context and detail.
  • Record metadata and write accurate captions for the photographs you take.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
